regime.summary: Policy rate held at 11.5% on 2026-06-15 while CPI jumped from 7.29% to 11.08% in three months, so real rates are about zero and the next move is likelier up than down. T-bills sit at the policy rate, so no cut is priced. Index is down 2.5% in a month after a strong 3m. Hold-decision base rate is mildly positive. Stay neutral with a modest core and no entries.

core.thesis: Cheap and paying: P/E 5.58, dividend yield 6.8%, 12m return +50% yet 8.8% below its 252-day high. Brent is 85 USD after a 13.8% 3m fall, a mild headwind, so size is small. Held as a liquid value anchor, not an edge claim; base rates give no signal for names.

Islamic bank near its 252-day high (4.6% below), P/E 8.82, yield 6.3%, 12m +60%. Foreign investors bought commercial banks over 5 and 20 sessions. Rates are held, not rising yet, which helps carry. Risk is a hike if CPI keeps rising.

watch.subject: Next MPC decision
watch.trigger: If CPI stays above the 11.5% policy rate or T-bills reprice above it, treat a hike as the base case and cut bank and rate-sensitive weight; a hold with CPI easing keeps the core.
